topic: How dominant is Applied Materials in fab MES/CIM software?
disagreement: Applied claims >70% of new 300 mm fabs choose its 300works MES; Frost & Sullivan's China data put 'Company A' (very likely Applied) at 42.5% of China's semiconductor IMSS revenue in 2024.
possible_reasons: population: count of new 300 mm fabs (global, unstated period) vs revenue of all fab-software modules in China
definition: MES only vs broad IMSS incl. YMS, SPC, EAP, test management
method: vendor marketing claim without method vs issuer-commissioned analyst estimate
identity: Company A is not named in the prospectus
rationale: The figures measure different things; neither refutes the other. Together they suggest Applied leads but does not hold a majority of China fab-software revenue.
remaining_uncertainty: No independent global MES share data; Applied's claim period and base are undisclosed.
